title: Mean, Median and Mode
seo_title: Mean, Median and Mode – SSS 1 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Find the mean, median and mode of ungrouped and grouped data; use the assumed mean; find missing values from the mean. (summary of the NERDC SSS 1 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free SSS 1 maths worksheets on measures of central tendency: mean, median and mode of lists and frequency tables, assumed mean and the modal class. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Median is the middle value in order.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Mean = total of the values ÷ how many values.
  • Put the values in order to find the median. With an even number, take the mean of the middle two.
  • The mode is the most common value; for grouped data, the modal class.

Examples

Example

3, 7, 8, 8, 9

Sum 35, 5 values

Answer: Mean 7, median 8, mode 8

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Finding the median without orderingPut the values in order first.
Dividing Σfx by the number of classesDivide by Σf.
Mixing up mode and frequencyThe mode is the value, not how many.
